subject.title: Add session workspace file preview editing

question: Should OpenClaw core ship an admin-scoped `sessions.files.set` method that can create or overwrite UTF-8 files under a resolved session workspace root once this PR is ported to the current Control UI architecture?
rationale: The code review can check scopes, fs-safe containment, and tests, but accepting a new core Gateway file-write surface is a maintainer security/product boundary decision.

options.title: Port and approve admin writer
options.body: Port the UI to the current chat workspace components and approve the admin-only writer if the fs-safe root and conflict checks match the intended product boundary.

options.title: Narrow the writer first
options.body: Require the PR to limit saves to maintainer-approved paths, such as previously previewed or touched text files, before accepting the boundary.

options.title: Do not ship core editing
options.body: Close or defer the PR if session workspace editing should stay out of core Control UI for now.

recommendation.title: Port and approve admin writer
recommendation.body: Port the UI to the current chat workspace components and approve the admin-only writer if the fs-safe root and conflict checks match the intended product boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the most recent merged current-main chat workspace viewer/sidebar work and is the best routed owner for the active UI plus product boundary decision.
